title: Local vector memory store
description: Replace AWS S3 Vectors in local MVP mode using Qdrant as the local provider for vector indexing/search while keeping AWS mode unchanged. Scope includes provider abstraction, env/config wiring, local compose runtime, and smoke proof for VectorTopicMemory end-to-end behavior.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Direction update:
- Local vector-store provider choice is Qdrant.
- Goal: replace AWS S3 Vectors usage in local mode for VectorTopicMemory while keeping AWS mode unchanged.
- Scope includes provider abstraction, Qdrant service in local smoke stack, env/config wiring, and local vector-memory smoke proof.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation status: Qdrant provider adapter, provider factory wiring, local compose/runtime integration, and vector-topic-memory smoke coverage are now implemented in the feature branch. Local proof harness passes end-to-end with no hosted GraphQL upstream requests, and local mode now runs VectorTopicMemory with Qdrant plus MinIO-backed artifact persistence.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Completion update:
- Implemented provider abstraction and Qdrant adapter for VectorTopicMemory with local env/config wiring.
- Added local compose/runtime integration for Qdrant and vector smoke orchestration.
- Added regression coverage for adapter/provider wiring and local block behavior.
- Added local proof step for VectorTopicMemory and verified no hosted GraphQL upstream forwarding.

Verification:
- poetry run pytest -q plexus/analysis/topic_clusterer_test.py plexus/analysis/embedding_cache_test.py plexus/analysis/qdrant_vector_store_test.py plexus/analysis/vector_store_factory_test.py plexus/reports/blocks/vector_topic_memory_test.py
- bash scripts/smoke-local-vector-topic-memory.sh
- bash scripts/prove-local-control-plane.sh

Notes:
- Local mode now uses deterministic Qdrant point IDs and S3-compatible embedding cache configuration for MinIO.
- BERTopic dependency absence in local mode now falls back to KMeans clustering for MVP smoke continuity.
